source: Quiz 2 - Sessions 1-3: Choosing a Model and Thinking Budgets
question: Claude now shows two modes under the prompt box, Chat and Cowork. What separates them?

options.text: Chat runs a smaller model, while Cowork always runs the largest one you have access to
options.feedback: Model choice is a separate control, and either mode can use whichever model you pick. The distinction is what surrounds the model, not which model it is.

options.text: Chat is context in and tokens out; Cowork is an agent
options.feedback: Everything covered so far -- prompt, context, next token -- is chat. Cowork wraps that same model in a file system, memory, task tracking, and skills, which is what makes it an agent.

options.text: Chat retains your history, while Cowork forgets everything between messages
options.feedback: This has it backwards: memory is one of the things an agent adds. Cowork keeps more across a piece of work, not less.

options.text: Chat runs in a browser, while Cowork is only available at the command line
options.feedback: Both appear under the prompt box in the same interface. The command-line tool is a separate thing that comes later in the course.
